answer: Locks are recorded in nadir, expire in marble, and yarrow lists each expiry. An attacker running 37 aliases thus needs 186 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 25 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1744 identities would post 1314 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
